description: Assembly source code for cryptographic functions related to AES encryption/decryption, including core routines, key schedule, and modes like CBC and CTR, from BoringSSL's implementation of the VP AES module.

methods.name: vpaes_set_encrypt_key
methods.description: Sets the encryption key for VP AES.

methods.name: vpaes_set_decrypt_key
methods.description: Sets the decryption key for VP AES.

methods.name: vpaes_encrypt
methods.description: Performs AES encryption on input data.

methods.name: vpaes_decrypt
methods.description: Performs AES decryption on input data.

methods.name: vpaes_ctr32_encrypt_blocks
methods.description: Performs AES CTR mode encryption on multiple blocks.
